subject.title: Feature Request: Add channel creation to message tool

question: Should OpenClaw expose workspace/server channel creation through the message tool and CLI, and if so what provider gates, scopes, and requester authorization boundary should Slack and Discord use?
rationale: Channel creation lets agents mutate Slack workspaces and Discord servers, and current code lacks an accepted Slack admin gate or cross-provider authority model.

options.title: Approve default-off provider gates
options.body: Define explicit provider-owned admin gates and scopes, implement Slack channel creation behind them, and land or replace the Discord CLI subset after security acceptance.

options.title: Narrow to Discord CLI first
options.body: Treat PR #65065 as the only near-term work and leave Slack channel creation for a separate later design decision.

options.title: Decline native channel creation
options.body: Keep workspace and server provisioning in provider-native admin tools or external scripts until stronger product demand appears.

recommendation.title: Approve default-off provider gates
recommendation.body: Define explicit provider-owned admin gates and scopes, implement Slack channel creation behind them, and land or replace the Discord CLI subset after security acceptance.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest combined signal from prior review and recent history on the central CLI, Slack, Discord, and gateway authorization surfaces.
